RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel raises legitimate concerns about diversity and unconscious similarity bias, but it alone does not prove discrimination. Department head roles frequently prioritize management credentials and broad leadership experience over advanced academic degrees (such as a PhD versus a master's). Furthermore, a two-week wait for formal HR feedback is routine and not necessarily suspicious.

Raising gender bias directly without evidence risks damaging professional relationships. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback. If hospital hiring policies require gender-balanced panels, you can ask neutral procedural questions about the selection composition, or consult a union or employment specialist before deciding on any formal challenge.
